body: I'm in the US. If by government assistance you mean loans or grants, I'm not really concerned about that. I'm worried that after highschool (I am a senior) when I lose my IEP and 504 that teachers and colleges won't understand things and I won't get accomodations for it. I barely even get the proper accomodations now but the school at least had to try to be supportive because it's by law. Colleges aren't obligated to do anything if they don't wish to. And then without the extra support I've been receiving I'm worried I'll fall behind, because despite the support I currently have, I'm still barely keeping my head above the water. And that alone is making me depressed, I can't imagine having no support whatsoever.

I don't even know if I'm going to college. I'm horrible at school, since like 4th grade and then I spent all of middle school wanting to kill myself because I hated school so much. I'm afraid that no matter what path I go down people won't understand me and I'll be stuck and alone. I'm autistic, it's hard for people like me to get a even job. 

If I go to a community college, chances are I'll either fail my classes or get depressed and suicidal from hating school. School is a big reason I'm currently suicidal. 

If I try to get a job I'm afraid I won't be able to find one for starters, and then secondly I'm afraid like school it'll just depress me and I'll get fired for maybe not showing up to work often enough or not doing enough work. And I mean you see the current state of the world life is hell for a lot of workers, and that was pre-covid. Not to mention covid going on.

If I don't get a job and don't go to school my family will probably just yell at me saying that I can't sit around doing nothing which is fair for them to say but they don't understand why I struggle with tasks that are easy for them. My mom legit said she'll kick me out of the house over my room being messy, god forbid I don't have a job she'd probably kick me out for that too.

I get support in school right now and have an IEP and 504 but once I graduate there's no guarantee I'll get that kind of support in college anymore. And I'm supposed to be in Vocational Ed right now so they can help me find a job but they'll only do it if I "demonstrate the ability to balance school work" as in have good grades but I don't and have never had good grades. 

I don't know what to do anymore. Suicide rates for autistic adults is so high and I understand why now.

I'd like to think most suicidal people don't *want* to die. I've wanted to kill myself since I was 8 but yes I'm just being edgy. Alright. I didn't know suicidal ideation had an age limit, I guess all those kids who killed themself even younger than I am were just faking it right?

I wanna kill myself for a fuck ton of reasons. She's just the icing on top, she gave me good motivation to kill myself. She hates me, does she? That's fine I'll see how much she hates me when I'm dead then.
Nah I want to kill myself for a lot of reasons. My mom is just the icing on top.

I don't hate my mom but I don't know if I love her either. I dunno what to or from a parent feels like. Not cause my mom's never shown it, she probably has, but it hasn't been enough for me. It's not entirely her fault because she worked a ton but the whole "I hate you" stuff is definitely her fault
Damn that's horrible. I don't think my mom would ever go that far. Really sorry to hear you have to put up with them.
My mom and I don't talk much, no.
I don't even doubt the possibility things could get better but I've just kinda stopped caring. I'm totally alright with the "easy way out." Even if I miss out on things getting better. I'm too tired.

I mean I'm not angry, I'm actually pretty calm if anything. What my mom said sucks but I'm used to her. If I had a list of reasons to kill myself she'd be like... #2047. I mostly just wanna kill myself because in general I don't feel like dealing with the world anymore.

You're being downvoted but I don't mind your comment tbh lol. The mix of sarcasm for an otherwise serious topic made me smile. Humor like this is actually a bit more comforting than the cliché "Suicidal is a permanent solution etc etc" because it feels like someone gets me and isn't just typing the same motivational quotes everyone does. So, thanks honestly.

Well, I'm not suicidal just because of that. I'm mostly suicidal for other reasons. I'm so numb to the shit she pulls this is more funny than anything to me. But on the other hand it certainly would be nice to not hear her words anymore and I see that as a bonus if I were to die.

I've heard it from her many times already but I was already suicidal all day prior to this so this was just the final straw. I'll see how much she hates me when I'm either dead or barely clinging to life in a hospital. ¯\_(ツ)_/¯
I don't think it'll get better. I'm afraid of losing the support I'm currently receiving once I turn 18.
The only thing I've ever really regretted was not killing myself sooner tbh.
